sources.title: GitHub - CGCL-codes/RecToM: Official dataset, evaluation scripts, and ...
sources.snippet: RecToM is a benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) within recommendation dialogues. LLMs must infer users' Beliefs, Desires, and Intents during multi-turn interactions—skills essential for building context-aware and effective recommender systems.

sources.title: KunalKurve/rca-agentic-ai - GitHub
sources.snippet: RAG Retriever: Performs semantic search over SOPs and historical incident reports using FAISS and SentenceTransformers. Causal Reasoning: Uses a Groq-hosted LLaMA model to infer the most likely root cause from logs, anomalies, maintenance data, and retrieved documents.

sources.title: [2501.14892] Causal Graphs Meet Thoughts: Enhancing Complex Reasoning ...
sources.snippet: This paper proposes a novel pipeline that filters large knowledge graphs to emphasize cause-effect edges, aligns the retrieval process with the model's chain-of-thought (CoT), and enhances reasoning through multi-stage path improvements.
